notes: LS-CWxx10-10I ordering: 1270~1570nm CWDM, -40°C~+85°C industrial; LS-CWxx10-10C: 0°C~+85°C (table lists 0~+70°C standard). Transmitter centre wavelength λc is per-channel code (λc-6.5 to λc+6.5 nm). Optical power launched into SMF (Note 1). Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^31-1 @ 10312Mbps, BER ≤1×10^-12 (Note 3). Power supply Icc max 320 mA at 3.135–3.465 V; consumption in W not stated. Absolute max storage temperature -40 to +85°C; operating case also listed as Standard 0 to +70°C, Extended -20 to +85°C.
